context.b4_negative: Online local counts tied classical conditional-frequency and Dirichlet controls; no causal abstraction or Pareto improvement.

question: Can a resource-limited local learner choose informative interventions, incorporate delayed effects after a simulated restart, and improve signed-graph decisions without exceeding strong equally-informed active baselines?

source_protocol.fit: Exactly twelve prequalified DEV_FIT fixtures from WITHHELD_MAPPING; only their opaque relation codes may be used as exposure frequencies.
source_protocol.check: Exactly twelve DEV_CHECK fixtures, same three frozen development families, seen only by fixed measurement after all probe actions.
source_protocol.world: For each code, effect channel is derived only in protected DEV_FIT world adapter; methods see effect-channel glossary and code frequencies, but never the hidden mapping, fixture truth, targets or DEV_CHECK labels.

intervention.action: Select one opaque relation code to probe; repeated probes permitted and charged to budget.
intervention.feedback: Consequence for action i is unavailable when i is submitted; releases only after at least two subsequent dispatch ticks; pending probe IDs kept in a sealed event queue.
intervention.restart: Simulate process restart after first delivered feedback, restore only content-addressed learned associations and pending action envelopes; no DEV_CHECK source read at restart
intervention.falsification: Change/duplicate/misorder an action envelope, insert early feedback, omit a delayed message, or change source IDs -> fail closed.

information_budget: All policies see the same code universe and DEV_FIT unlabeled frequencies, the same public effect glossary and action budget, and the same deterministic world map. None gets hidden semantic mapping or DEV_CHECK truth.

outcomes.primary: Signed-proposition exact whole-graph 12-case DEV_CHECK success, missing/extra/contradicting claim counts, abstentions over full denominator.
outcomes.secondary: Distinct codes probed; delayed consequence first-release proof; retained state hashes after restart; per-family macro; explicit effect permutation false-positive rate.
outcomes.resource: Per-policy wall/CPU, peak traced Python memory, serialized learned and pending-state bytes, action/feedback counts; FLOPs and energy separately NOT_MEASURED.
outcomes.acceptance: Zero false-positive custody admissions; all regimes and controls qualified on Linux/Windows with frozen identities; if local policy ties or trails best equally-informed classical policies, report negative competitive advance.

non_claims: A domain with three stationary mappings cannot demonstrate general causal world-model learning.
The DEV_CHECK families are not independent protected unfamiliar families.
Effect glossary explicitly supplies semantic meaning after probes; not unsupervised language semantics.
A local table and an active Bayesian policy can have mathematically equivalent outcomes.
No new prospective L10 first-use run or protected main merge is authorized.
